mapper.select: SELECT a.*, p.pet_name, p.photo as pet_photo, p.species as pet_species, p.breed as pet_breed FROM adoption a LEFT JOIN pet p ON a.pet_id = p.pet_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.apply_time DESC

SELECT a.*, u.username, p.pet_name, p.photo as pet_photo, p.species as pet_species, p.breed as pet_breed FROM adoption a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN pet p ON a.pet_id = p.pet_id WHERE a.adopt_id = #{adoptId}
mapper.update: UPDATE adoption SET status = #{status}, audit_opinion = #{auditOpinion}, audit_admin_id = #{auditAdminId}, audit_time = NOW() WHERE adopt_id = #{adoptId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM adoption WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND pet_id = #{petId} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
